dialogues.speaker: Qinglian
dialogues.text: That's right, people in Sumeru will grind down gemstones into a powder to make cosmetics with. It's supposed to be good for skincare.

dialogues.speaker: Qinglian
dialogues.text: It seems there are researchers who specialize in studying the skincare effects of different gemstone powders on varied skin types.

dialogues.speaker: Qinglian
dialogues.text: But because the gemstones they use are so expensive and often need to be imported from Liyue, this is something quite luxurious that only the wealthy in Sumeru can enjoy.

dialogues.speaker: Qinglian
dialogues.text: It got me thinking, Liyue has an abundance of precious ores. If this practice could be brought back there, it's possible it could open up a whole new market...
